# Postman Schemas

> JSON Schemas (draft-07) for the Postman Collection format. Use them to generate, validate and explain Postman Collections, and to migrate between versions. Target Collection v3.0.0 for new work; v2.1.0 is the previous version.

Notes for agents:

- Target v3.0.0 for new work. Use v2.1.0 when the collection is a single JSON file exported from the Postman app, must run in Newman, or will be imported by tools that only read v2.1.
- The v3.0.0 JSON Schema describes a whole collection as one JSON document. It is not the schema of the on-disk v3 format, where Postman splits a collection into many YAML files (`*.request.yaml`, `definition.yaml`, `.resources/`). Don't validate those files against it; see the Learning Center links below.
- Pin a version. Don't use the `/latest/` URLs: they move between releases and differ by draft (`/collection/json/latest/draft-04/` is v2.1.0, `/collection/json/latest/draft-07/` is v3.0.0).
- The raw schemas can be fetched from any origin (CORS allows all). Internal `$ref`s are kept, not dereferenced.

Key differences from v2.1.0 to v3.0.0:

- No `info` block. `name` and `$kind: "collection"` are required at the top level, and there is no `info.schema` URL.
- `event` (with `listen` set to `prerequest` or `test`) is replaced by `scripts`. On a request, a script's `type` is a lifecycle point such as `beforeRequest` or `afterResponse` (HTTP); on a collection or folder it is prefixed with the protocol, such as `http:beforeRequest` or `grpc:beforeInvoke`.

## Schemas

- [Collection v3.0.0 JSON Schema](https://schema.postman.com/collection/json/v3.0.0/draft-07/collection.json): The current collection format. Each item has a `$kind`: HTTP, GraphQL, gRPC, WebSocket, Socket.IO, MQTT, Kafka, MCP and LLM requests, or a folder.
- [Collection v2.1.0 JSON Schema](https://schema.postman.com/collection/json/v2.1.0/draft-07/collection.json): The previous collection format, used by Postman app exports and Newman. Requires `info` and `item`.

## Postman Learning Center

- [Collections schemas](https://learning.postman.com/docs/use/use-collections/collections-schemas.md): The on-disk v3.0.0 format: YAML files, directory layout and naming rules.
- [Postman CLI collection commands](https://learning.postman.com/docs/postman-cli/postman-cli-collections.md): `postman collection migrate` (v2.1 JSON to v3 YAML), `postman collection lint` (check a collection against the v3 format), `get` and `run`.
- [Migrate from Newman to the Postman CLI](https://learning.postman.com/docs/reference/newman-cli/migrate-to-postman-cli.md): Newman runs only v2.1 collections; the Postman CLI runs v3.

## Optional

- [Collection v3.0.0 documentation](https://schema.postman.com/collection/json/v3.0.0/draft-07/docs/index.html): Browsable HTML view of the v3.0.0 schema, for people.
- [Collection v2.1.0 documentation](https://schema.postman.com/collection/json/v2.1.0/draft-07/docs/index.html): Browsable HTML view of the v2.1.0 schema, for people.
- [Postman Learning Center llms.txt](https://learning.postman.com/llms.txt): Index of all Postman documentation.
